description: This file contains benchmarking code for sparse matrix multiplication (SpMM) using different sparse matrix formats (CSR, COO, and both). It defines functions to generate sparse matrices, perform timing tests, and parse command-line arguments to run the tests and output results.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: A class for timing events, with methods to record timestamps and compute elapsed time.

methods.name: test_sparse_csr
methods.description: Performs timing tests on sparse CSR matrix multiplication.

methods.name: test_sparse_coo
methods.description: Performs timing tests on sparse COO matrix multiplication.

methods.name: test_sparse_coo_and_csr
methods.description: Performs timing tests on both COO and CSR sparse matrix multiplications and returns their average times.
